{{Quote|Jabba has sent me, Aponte, to give you a quick preview of some of the great things he has planned for the big celebration.|Aponte|<ref name="SWG:DFtR" />}}
'''Aponte''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] individual who lived during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], he was sent by [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]] to promote and inform people about the [[Galactic Moon Festival]] created by the Hutt. Aponte worked along with [[Z'ozpheratu]] to create elaborate events in [[Moenia/Legends|Moenia]] and [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].<ref name="SWG:DFtR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Aponte is mentioned in the ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' website's article titled "Don't Fear the Reaper,"<ref name="SWG:DFtR" /> that served as introduction for the Galactic Moon Festival in-game event.<ref name="SWG:GMF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=event|Galactic Moon Festival}}</ref>
